The Business Development Engineer will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, building relationships with key customers and partners, and providing technical support to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction in the assigned region.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets.
• Build and maintain existing relationships with key customers and partners.
• Provide technical support to customers and partners to ensure successful implementation and usage of the technology.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and operations, to ensure effective sales strategies and customer satisfaction.
• Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
• Develop and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, and technical papers to customers and partners.
• Manage and track sales activities, forecasts, and pipelines.
• Provide regular sales reports and insights to senior management to inform business decisions.
• Travel up to 25% / 30% of the time in the assigned region, to meet with customers and partners. 
Desired profile

• Technical bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical sales role.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
• Proven track record of success in developing and executing sales strategies that drive revenue growth.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and in a team environment, with a high level of self-motivation and a results-driven approach.
• Fluency in English is required, other languages are a plus. 
Offer

• We offer you a challenging job in a healthy, growing company with a clear vision of the future. You will cooperate with a driven and enthusiastic team.
• We offer a competitive salary complete with extra-legal benefits such as a company car, meal vouchers, ecovouchers, hospital and group insurance.

Your role

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. Acting as the technical owner of the electrical design, you will bridge project requirements and practical implementation, ensuring that every machine is engineered according to the highest quality and safety standards.

Your responsibilities

Electrical design and project planning

• Starting from the conceptual phase, you will participate in the project design meetings where you will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the collaborative planning meetings in order to create a realistic project planning.
• After the concept phase, you will take ownership of the electrical descriptions: you will translate the draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear and detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design of the project.
• Based on these electrical descriptions, you will design and adjust the electrical drawings (Eplan P8).
• You will design the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Propanel.
• You ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN60204, MD, EMC, LVD, ...).
Execution and collaboration

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for the customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines.
• During the assembly process you will follow up closely with production.
• As a senior, you will also develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices and ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards.
• You will support your colleagues when necessary and will collaborate with them to review schematics for accuracy.
• You contribute actively to departmental standardization initiatives and gradually take ownership of driving these improvements forward. 
Your profile

• You have a Masters degree in industrial sciences in Electromechanics or Electrotechnics or are equivalent by experience.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in Electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building industry.
• This means you have a solid knowledge of electrical standards. Knowledge of UL standards is a plus.
• You have good knowledge of Eplan P8. Knowledge of Eplan Propanel is a plus.
• You have an analytical mind and are a problem solver.
• You're a good communicator and a team player in an international environment.
• You have a good knowledge of English and Dutch. 
Our offer

• We offer you a challenging job in an international, collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.
• A technical engineering role with opportunities to lead improvement initiatives and to have an impact.
• A competitive compensation package complemented by attractive benefits such as a company car.

Alongside your team, you'll delight our guests with our locally sourced organic breakfast or the nightly "Sounds in the Clouds," featuring captivating beats at our bar. For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system: 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

• Good numerical skills
